segments.subtask: The robot arm approaches the scattered letters on the table.
The robot arm grasps the letter 'B' from the table.
The robot arm moves the letter 'B' to the left side of the table.
The robot arm grasps the letter 'A' from the table.
The robot arm moves the letter 'A' to the left side of the table next to 'B'.
The robot arm grasps the letter 'I' from the table.
The robot arm moves the letter 'I' to the left side of the table next to 'A'.
The robot arm grasps the letter 'N' from the table.
The robot arm moves the letter 'N' to the left side of the table next to 'I'.
The robot arm places the letters in the correct order to spell 'brain'.
